before.requirement: Compile a pattern containing (?C) with PCRE2_EXTRA_NEVER_CALLOUT set to exercise callout rejection.
before.reason: Before the change, the public compile-extra-options mask excluded NEVER_CALLOUT and the (?C) parser had no corresponding rejection guard.

after.requirement: Compile a pattern containing (?C) with PCRE2_EXTRA_NEVER_CALLOUT set in the compile context, reaching the ERR103 rejection guard.
after.reason: The changed mask accepts the extra option and the parser checks it at (?C), but the fixed harness never sets compile extra options on its newly created context.

claims.reason: The option was unsupported before the change. Afterward, the same harness passes a context whose extra options remain zero, so input bytes cannot activate the new guard.
